title: Grateful Dead Live at US Festival, Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
venue: US Festival, Glen Helen Regional Park
lineage: Master Cassettes (JVC KD-A55 w/Super ANRS) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (.wav 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition 2024 > TLH 2496
source: Ken Kelley's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM-57 mics > JVC KD-2 w/Super ANRS (Maxell XLII-S90)

ai_review.summary: A wide‑spreading, solid soundboard capture of a concise, vintage‑vibe Dead show.
ai_review.review: The recording benefits from Shure SM57 cardioids used as room mics on the board, delivering clear, spacious sound that recalls the band’s classic ’60s drum tone. The concert itself was shorter than usual but still managed to convey the Dead’s retro energy within an eclectic 80s festival lineup.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review praises the wide‑spread, clear recording and a decent performance despite limited set length; recording quality is good while show lacks specific standout songs.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with Shure SM57 cardioids as room mics on the soundboard, providing a wide‑spread, clear mix and vintage drum character; no major flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shorter than a typical Dead set but maintains a classic 60s vibe in an 80s festival context.

band_member_comments.Drums: Reviewer highlights the classic 1969‑70 drum sound captured via SM57 mics.
